alpha.source: The volume-delay form of the Bureau of Public Roads (1964), Traffic Assignment Manual, as the methods document cites it; the values as commonly used: Boyles, Lownes and Unnikrishnan, Transportation Network Analysis, Volume I, version 1.0 (2025), section 1.5.1: 'It is common to use α = 0.15 and β = 4' (https://arxiv.org/html/2502.05182)

speed_floor_kph.source: The routing engine ignores a posted speed below 10 kilometres per hour (its documentation page 'Speeds': 'Values below 10 kph are ignored in lua'; measured on the installed version by task S1-T11); by the owner's decision of 2026-11-13 this is the floor of every released link speed.
speed_floor_kph.status: project rule by the owner's decision
